_doc: Picture/sound contract for hummingbird-metabolism. 30 fps. Frames come from voice/words.json (word start frames). Visual reactions land 0-3 frames before their word.

places.garden: Gus's back garden (kit town place, plain lawn, no hole): a garden table with a pile of hamburgers, deck chair, the neighbor's fence and grill
places.park: the town park (kit): only as a soft green backdrop for the hummingbird at its feeder
places.ocean: open sea (kit) by day, at sunset and at night: the fisherman's rowboat, no pipe

shots.what: HOOK. Medium shot, already moving: Gus (pyjamas, fishbowl tipped back like a lid) behind a garden table with two heaps of hamburgers, a burger in each hand, biting left, right, left (chomps f17, f40, f62), cheeks full, crumbs flying. From 'that's not even' (f84) steam leaks out round his head, his face turns worried and the lens pushes in on it (whoosh f116). White flash at 131.

Morning garden, full shot. Gus asleep in the deck chair, sleep bubble at his nose. A hummingbird zips in from screen right (f150) and hovers at his helmet. The bubble pops and he jolts awake on 'woke' (f174); the bird taps the glass with a sparkle on 'metabolism' (f194) and darts off on 'hummingbird' (f222). Slow push-in, a glide closer centred on the wake-up.

Close-up in the park, trees melted by the lens: the hummingbird hovers at a red feeder on a hook, wings a blur. On 'burns' (f302) a little flame jets from its tail like an afterburner; from 'fifty' (f322) to 'does' (f366) the nectar level in the glass drains to the bottom. Slow push-in.

Wide of Gus at the table, looking small. A tower of hamburgers stacks up beside him, one burger after another from 'that's' (f409), faster and faster, far over his head; the lens tilts up with it. The last one lands on 'day' (f470); the tower sways, Gus looks up and gulps (f476).

Two-shot: his wife, deadpan, flips pancake after pancake out of the pan (flicks f495, f515, f535); each arcs across to Gus on the left, who catches it in his open mouth (chomps f507, f527, f547). On 'Gone.' (f558) the pan is empty; she turns it upside down and looks into the lens.

The neighbor over his fence, laughing, pointing at us, a sausage on his grill fork, his grill behind him. On 'loses' (f654) Gus pops up behind the fence right at the fork, mouth open, and bites the sausage off it (the fork is empty from f659); the lens glides right to hold both. Gus chews, the sausage end sticking out of his mouth until f676; the neighbor stares at his empty fork, then jaw-drops on 'grill' (f698).

Medium close-up of Gus, helmet on. A red heart pops onto his chest (f714) and from 'beats' (f725) it buzzes: it shivers every frame with tick marks round it; he looks down and puts a hand to it. On 'that's a hum' (f797-811) vibration arcs spread from the heart and the hummingbird slides in beside his head, humming at the same rate.

'But wait': music cut dead. Close-up of his helmet: the glass fogs up white from the bottom, little steam puffs leak from the collar (hiss f862), his eyes peer over the fog line. A question mark pops beside the helmet on 'up?' (f885).

EXPLANATION. Medium shot of Gus holding up a hamburger: on 'into heat' (f941) it flares into a flame in his hand and wavy heat lines start rising off him; he lowers the hand (f962-976) as the lens glides back. On 'as much as four' a row of four space heaters pops in at his feet (the inner pair f1000, the outer pair f1014); their coils and a halo glow orange on 'heaters' (f1031) and Gus glows with them, a fifth heater.

The garden table, close: a single french fry on a plate, steaming on 'french fry' (hiss f1076). By 'cold' (f1098) the steam is gone and the fry turns pale blue with a tiny frost sparkle. Slow push-in.

Glide right along the table to a fat baked potato in foil, split open, a big steam plume rolling off it; it keeps steaming on 'stays hot' (f1169-1179) while a pat of butter melts on top. Slow push-in.

Wider: fry and potato side by side on the table, the fry cold and blue, the potato still steaming. On 'skin' (f1250) the outline of each lights up yellow with a sparkle: the thin fry is nearly all outline, the potato mostly inside.

The hummingbird again, close, hovering at the feeder. From 'so its heat' (f1392) red wavy heat lines lift off its back and tail in two waves, drift up and fade (f1392-1439); it shuts its eye, content, with a sparkle on 'away' (f1426). Slow push-in.

Medium shot of Gus standing exactly like the potato: a pat of butter lands on his helmet on 'baked' (f1459) and melts (f1471), a big steam plume rolls off the top of his head. He looks up at it, worried.
Closer: he holds up a thermometer; the red column races to the top from 'heats' (f1499) and the bulb pops on 'minute' (f1550). His face goes from nervous to shocked; kick on the pop.

'Luckily': open sea, a fisherman in his rowboat. Gus drops out of the sky in a cannonball (whistle f1561-1589) and hits the water in front of the boat on 'sea' (splash f1589). A cloud of steam hisses up (f1600). He surfaces neck-deep in the foreground (f1622) with a blissful smile, wisps of steam still rising; the fisherman behind him stares. The lens moves in as he comes up.

'Unluckily': close on Gus, neck-deep, open water behind him. His smile drops (gulp f1703), his stomach rumbles in fast rings on the water (f1717-1745), and on 'last ate' (f1748) a thought bubble with a hamburger pops over his head.

Sunset over the same sea: Gus neck-deep in the foreground, helmet tipped back, chewing, a burger in his raised hand; the fisherman dozes in the boat behind him. The hummingbird flies in from the left (zip f1772) and hovers at the boat's lantern. A question mark pops beside it on 'part?' (f1779).

Close on the hummingbird hovering by the boat's lantern, over the sleeping fisherman's sou'wester: eyelids drooping, wings slowing down, dipping. On 'like one' (f1861) it gives up and settles on top of the hat.

Night, moon and stars. Close on the bird perched on the yellow hat: it fluffs itself into a ball, and on 'shuts off' (f1919) its eye closes and a sleep bubble starts to swell. The fisherman under it is asleep too.

PAYOFF, wider: everyone asleep (the fisherman in his boat, the bird on his hat, two sleep bubbles) except Gus in the foreground, neck-deep in the moonlit water, helmet tipped back, looking miserable, a burger in his raised hand; he takes the next bite on 'breakfast' (chomp f1967) and chews. Ends on the last word.

events.note: morning garden under the hook, no music
steam starts to leak from his collar
Gus pops up behind the fence, the sausage is gone
the neighbor sees the empty grill
stands for the heart ticking twenty times a second
'that's a hum': the bird hums in
the burger turns into a flame: 'into heat'
a pat of butter lands on his helmet
Gus drops out of the sky
its wings slow down, it lands on the hat
